Jia (Billing Ops): Azure Feb settlement mismatch: statement shows 2,734 compute-hours, our logs 3,021 (delta 287 hrs).
Maria (Finance): Invoice id and subscription?
Jia (Billing Ops): AZ-MKT-2026-02-7891, sub_rwdw_09A
Jia (Billing Ops): Azure CSV excerpt: subscription,period_start,period_end,compute_hours,listed_price
sub_rwdw_09A,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,2734,0.38
Jia (Billing Ops): Our query: SELECT SUM(hours) ... -> 3021
Sam (Partnerships): Could be partner credits or late ingestion.
Azure Marketplace Bot: Settlement uploaded to s3://redwood-billing/azure/2026/02/statement_7891.csv
Maria (Finance): Pulling raw; will diff with ETL.
Jia (Billing Ops): 287 hrs missing -> est $109.06
Nina (Legal): 45-day dispute window check.
Jia (Billing Ops): Statement dated 2026-03-05, today 2026-03-12 -> within window.
Sam (Partnerships): Pinged AM (kyle@azure-partners) for line items.
Azure Marketplace Bot: AM (Kyle) replied: applied partner discount PRT-STD (affects price, not hours). Please share raw meter export.
Jia (Billing Ops): Uploaded internal export s3://redwood-billing/internal_exports/2026/02/sub_rwdw_09A_usage.csv
Sam (Partnerships): Asked if deferred resell or aggregation applied.
Jia (Billing Ops): 287 hrs from bulk job on 2026-02-27 02:10 UTC — possible late-reporting.
Maria (Finance): Drafting formal dispute email; need approvals.
Leo (Accounting): Approve; <$5k so Finance can send.
Maria (Finance): Sent formal dispute: requested reprocessing and credit memo if ingestion error confirmed.
Azure Marketplace Bot: Email delivered to azure-am@azure.com at 2026-03-12T14:22:31Z
Sam (Partnerships): AM: will reprocess; if included, credit memo or apply delta to next settlement. Needs PO.
Leo (Accounting): PO-2025-489
Sam (Partnerships): Added PO.
Azure Marketplace Bot: Azure queued reprocess (AZ-REQ-5581) ETA 5-7 business days.
Jia (Billing Ops): Marking pending vendor reprocess; reminder set for 2026-03-19.
Maria (Finance): Created FIN-2026-203 ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-203
Jia (Billing Ops): If not included, escalate. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
